This land is not mine, I am renting it, so I must be careful with money but still get a good maize harvest to feed my family and sell some at market. I will buy urea and NPK from the agro-dealer because without fertilizer the soil here in the North East will not give me enough maize, but I cannot afford a full dose so I will stretch it. I will use improved seed from last year's buying since the rains have been unpredictable, and I will spray against army worm because last season it ate many farms around us. There is no irrigation here, we depend on the rain, and my children and I will do most of the weeding ourselves but I will hire a few young men for land preparation and the second weeding.
